Following changes were made to customize OGG/Vorbis library:

================================================
Memory allocation using custom routines:

In ogg/os_types.h:

-- Old code:

#define _ogg_malloc  malloc
#define _ogg_calloc  calloc
#define _ogg_realloc realloc
#define _ogg_free    free

-- New code: 

#if 0

#define _ogg_malloc  malloc
#define _ogg_calloc  calloc
#define _ogg_realloc realloc
#define _ogg_free    free

#else

#include <stddef.h>

void *_ogg_malloc(size_t size);
void *_ogg_calloc(size_t num, size_t size);
void *_ogg_realloc(void *memblock, size_t size);
void _ogg_free(void *mem);

#endif

================================================
